BeFab currently has the capacity to produce over three tons of graphene and 2D materials annually, meeting the needs of diverse industries

Our vision extends beyond Befab’s current production capabilities. BeDimensional is actively pursuing ambitious plans for expansion, including the development of a second manufacturing facility in Italy, set to become operational in 2027. This new plant will significantly enhance our production capacity, allowing us to achieve an annual output of 30 tons of graphene and 2D materials by 2028.
Production Technology
Advanced Exfoliation Process

BeDimensional uses an advanced liquid-phase exfoliation process to produce high-quality 2D materials, including graphene and other advanced materials. Raw material (like graphite) is dispersed into a solvent, where energy is applied to separate individual layers, creating few-layer crystals that preserve the unique properties of 2D materials.

Our proprietary technique enables precise control over layer thickness. Using optimized parameters, we produce 2D crystals with thicknesses ranging from 1 to 3 nanometers, ensuring high conductivity and strength for advanced applications.

Our liquid-phase exfoliation process is scalable for industrial use, maintaining consistent quality and performance. This enables the widespread adoption of 2D crystals across sectors like energy storage, advanced coatings, and electronics.
Our graphene products comply with ISO/TS 80004‑13:2017 and ISO/TS 21356-1:2021 standards, ensuring the highest levels of quality and reliability.
